text:
lila: hi all — i'm Lila, Product Designer, starting today. quick q: i don't have Figma access yet and can't install the 'Redwood Components' plugin. who should I ping for perms? also where's the latest product roadmap doc? thanks!
sam: welcome Lila!! :tada: I'll add you to the Figma org. @morgan can you grant plugin install perms?
morgan: on it. can you DM me your work email? also FYI the plugin requires SSO to be provisioned, so may need 5–10 min after I add you.
lila: thanks — dm sent. also curious about research process: we have an ongoing study template? where do we store consent forms and recordings?
ethan: hey Lila — welcome. For research we use the Notion research hub: https://redwood.team/notion/research. Consent forms live in the 'Resources' page, recordings in secure S3 (reach out to me for access).
lila: appreciate it. what about roadmap ownership? who owns the quarterly doc for RDW-UX?
sam: I own the product roadmap for RDW-UX. I'll add you as a collaborator. There's also a short README at https://redwood.team/roadmap/ux that outlines cadence and monthly syncs.
morgan: Plugin perms done — you should see email invite. if Figma still blocks plugin, try clearing browser cache or use the desktop app. quick check command: `figma://open?file=xxxxxxxx`
lila: invite arrived! installing plugin now... :crossed_fingers:
devex-bot: deploy-bot: New hire checklist — Lila added to 'Design' Figma team, Notion access granted, Slack channels autojoined: #design, #product. Welcome pack sent.
joan: hey Lila, I'm Joan on Research Ops — if you need a quick walkthrough of the study template, happy to pair for 30 mins today. ping me when free.
lila: perfect, can meet at 3pm PT. thanks everyone!
